caption: An oval mug with open mouth and a pierced loop handle. A sealed base sits beneath cavity walls; the right-hand loop handle joins the cup by its upper and lower roots. A thick rim and a sealed base connect the oval continuous walls that enclose the cavity. Overall width is 1.30 times depth; height is 0.46 times width. Parts follow functional positions. Continuous blue, dark brown, tan color regions distinguish the body and attachments. The front reveals functional parts; side and top views reveal depth, connections and layout.
